mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.product_id, p.product_name, o.quantity, o.order_status, o.order_date, o.delivery_date, o.delete_flg FROM t_order o INNER JOIN m_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.delete_flg = 0 ORDER BY o.order_id
SELECT product_id, product_name FROM m_product WHERE delete_flg = 0 ORDER BY product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order ( order_no, customer_name, product_id, quantity, order_status, order_date, delivery_date, delete_flg ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{customerName}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderDate}, #{deliveryDate}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, order_no, customer_name, product_id, quantity, order_status, order_date, delivery_date, delete_flg FROM t_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET order_no = #{orderNo}, customer_name = #{customerName}, product_id = #{productId}, quantity = #{quantity}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, order_date = #{orderDate}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
